2026-11-13 07:04:23.295963 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-11-13 07:04:23.295968 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-13 07:04:23.295973 | controller |
2026-11-13 07:04:23.299515 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-13 07:04:23.299525 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-13 07:04:23.299529 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-13 07:04:23.299532 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-13 07:04:23.299536 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
